implemented.objective: Public geometric waypoint reach credit minus round-trip path-length effort. No removal reward, cavity or tissue cutting is simulated.
implemented.candidate_generation: Deterministic six-neighbor interior T1-support quantiles, support-bound hypothetical entry plane and fixed full tool catalogue. Private MRA, annotations, registration and coverage never affect candidate generation, legality or nominal ranking.
implemented.geometry: Existing full-tool geometry checks require starting pose outside nominal support, public ROI/coverage containment, aperture/angle/reach and complete insertion plus reverse withdrawal. Ordinary tissue remains exposure. Independent motion checks certify every complete selected history before private loading.
implemented.methods: SEARCH exhaustively ranks the common legal table plus STOP. HYBRID can order that full search but cannot prune it or replace the public optimum. IL/RL/HYBRID callable interfaces are exercised only by explicitly scripted generated controls; no learned policy/checkpoint result is claimed.
implemented.sealed_boundary: All four statuses are fixed before scoring; complete action histories, tool dimensions, metrics, budgets and source hashes are bound. Failed/abstained slots remain null. STOP is complete but does not reach a waypoint. A modified SEARCH/HYBRID record cannot select STOP over a better public option.
implemented.private_scoring: One common generated MRA/positive-mask/domain snapshot is loaded after all seals and independent preflights. Exact array hashes, directed rigid frame mapping and effective domain intersection are checked. The existing tiled segment-box contact kernel unions insertion/withdrawal exposure for shaft, tip and whole tool. Unknown coverage is retained; no vessel-free or injury claim.
implemented.tamper_controls: Type-sensitive seals/budgets, complete and noncomplete accounting, public metadata invariants and shared source bytes are checked. A later seal or task mutation invalidates all batch scores. Caller private mapping/array mutation cannot change the captured scoring snapshot.

verified_end_to_end_assertions: Both insertion and reverse-withdrawal legs persist in each selected corridor strategy.

Changing the private generated positive mask changes measured contacts while every actor contract, candidate and sealed method strategy stays identical.
No nominal generation or geometry preflight occurs after the private callback.
Public unknown coverage produces four abstention slots and no private load; failed and voluntary-abstention selectors do not become STOP.
A legitimate exhaustive STOP remains allowed when every legal corridor has negative public value.

science_review_limits.verdict: Conditional GO for generated interface controls
science_review_limits.waypoint_count_two: Two waypoints in one batch define joint waypoint-and-tool selection, not route choice to a fixed target. All methods still receive the same candidates.
science_review_limits.first_acquired_data_ablation: Use one waypoint per sealed batch, with at most two prospectively fixed batches per person. Analyze target-choice separately if later enabled; do not replace an unreachable target using private labels.
science_review_limits.waypoint_reached: Public geometric tip-position proxy, not surgically achieved access.
science_review_limits.one_step_scope: Cannot establish sequential RL advantage, tissue penetration, surgical safety or clinical efficacy.

supported_arrays_and_resources.planning_ROI: Entire supplied orthogonal RAS grid, each edge at most16 cells, exact float32 T1 and boolean support/coverage. No implicit crop/resample or hidden outside-ROI shaft permission.
supported_arrays_and_resources.private_ROI: At most32 cells per edge; identical MRA/annotation grid with exact positive-mask and annotation/MRA/registration domain bindings.
supported_arrays_and_resources.decision: Horizon1, at most2 waypoints and2 tools; at most4 corridor rows plus STOP. Three public geometry checks per generated candidate; two independent motion checks per selected non-STOP history.
supported_arrays_and_resources.private_scoring_budget: Existing tiled contact budget,10-second cooperative cap per completed method. Arbitrary callbacks need separate process supervision; this is accidental-misuse protection, not hostile-code containment.
